witness.text: Embedded software engineer with four years of experience at Ridgeway Appliances, leading firmware development for washing‑machine and dryer control boards.
Expertise in C programming, unit testing with Unity and Ceedling, and hardware‑in‑the‑loop regression testing.
Led firmware architecture and release decisions for the washer platform, coordinating with platform lead and quality engineer.
Supported hardware engineers during board bring‑up and implemented IEC 60730 class B self‑test procedures.

Completed IEC 60730 class B self‑test checklist for the door‑lock driver module.
Door‑lock driver module with unit tests and IEC 60730 class B self‑test checklist (source src_605532b4ccba).
